clusters.name: After Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Bea was born in March 1995, a third child ten years after you. Within months, your mother was worn out and on edge with the baby, your parents grew distant with your father working late most nights, you developed stomach aches and missed school, your brother had shouting matches with your father, and your mother's functioning fell as she did not return to her job. Five shifts counting toward difficulty piled up over a year around this change in the family.
